caption: The drawing features two objects placed against a plain, light beige background. In the upper left, there is a detailed depiction of a metallic tool consisting of a curved, semi-circular band with six evenly spaced, protruding rectangular prongs along its outer edge, each one at a right angle to the band. Attached to one end of the band is a long, straight handle that tapers off and terminates in a circular loop. The tool is rendered in shades of brown, gray, and muted bronze to suggest an aged, metallic surface. Below and to the right of the tool, there is a simplified outline or impression of the pronged band, depicted as a thin, arching line with six straight extensions radiating outward from the arch, matching the spacing of the prongs on the tool above. The impression is drawn in a lighter, reddish-brown hue. The composition is sparse, with both objects isolated in the center of the drawing and ample blank space around them.
title: Branding Iron
